desc: The Q, LLC Lefty 5.56 mm and 6 mm ARC SS Melonite Quickie Fast-Attach Low-Blow Silencer is a high-performance rifle suppressor engineered to provide effective sound and flash reduction for 5.56 NATO and compatible calibers like 6 mm ARC while minimizing blowback and enhancing durability. Built with robust stainless steel and Inconel construction and finished with a corrosion-resistant melonite or nitride coating, this compact silencer uses Q’s Quickie Fast-Attach system for rapid, secure mounting and detachment, making it easy to switch between firearms or cleaning sessions. The design incorporates an optimized bore and internal geometry that helps reduce gas blowback toward the shooter and improves overall suppression performance without restrictive barrel length limits, making it suitable for short-barreled rifles (SBRs) and full-length carbines alike. With a lightweight, compact profile and rugged materials, the Lefty Quickie suppressor balances versatility, convenience, and high-end construction for precision shooters, tactical applications, and range use.
